8.30.1.1. iLock_Geography.predicate_library.position.NextObject.__init__¶

NextObject.__init__(startUserTypes, endUserTypes=None, startFacing=None, endFacing=None, onlyFirstMatch=True, branch=True, posOrient=None, startCondition=None, endCondition=None, restriction=None, edgeCondition=None, argOrder=None)¶

Constructor.

Parameters:
  • startUserTypes (Iterable(string)) – User types of source objects.
  • endUserTypes (Iterable(string)) – User types of dest objects.
  • startFacing (bool?) – If True (False), an object can be considered as source in the true point only if it is facing (trailing). An argument of None (default) can be interpreted as “no restriction”.
  • endFacing (bool?) – If True (False), an object can be considered as a dest in the true point only if it is facing (trailing). An argument of None (default) can be interpreted as “no restriction”.
  • onlyFirstMatch (bool) – Recommended to use the default value which is True.
  • branch (bool) – If True (default), a source object can have multiple dest objects by traversing a node with degree bigger than 2.
  • posOrient (bool?) – If True (default), dest objects are lied in the positive direction of source objects in the true points. If False, source objects are lied in the positive direction of dest objects in the true points. An argument of None is interpreted as “no restriction”.
  • startCondition (callable) – A callable having signature (obj, index, railyard) -> bool. Default is None.
  • endCondition (callable) – A callable having signature (obj, index, railyard) -> bool. Default is None.
  • argOrder (vtuple(int)?) – See GeoPredicate.
